sloka: सा तस्योपरि चोल्काभा पतन्तीव बभौ गदा ।इन्द्रप्रमुक्ता गर्जन्ती गिराविव महाशनिः ।। ७.२७.४८ ॥
transliteration: sā tasyopari colkābhā patantīva babhau gadā ।indrapramuktā garjantī girāviva mahāśaniḥ ।। 7.27.48 ॥

translations.english: That mace, resembling a falling meteor, shone as it descended upon him, like a great thunderbolt released by Indra roaring down upon a mountain.
